title: ECL_T0 + SSY_PLANE sidereal projection (J2000 coordinate plumbing)
execution_record: Two commits: 2f10465 (plumbing + math) and d27d0e2 (golden tests). Placed trop_ra2sid_lon / trop_ra2sid_lon_sosy in ayanamsa.rs (not calc.rs) to avoid circular dep — ayanamsa.rs already imports EphemerisConfig. Used [0.0;6] sentinel for MeanNode/MeanApogee/EclipticNutation paths (no meaningful x2000), guarded by != in apply_sidereal. SSY_PLANE_NODE_E2000/SSY_PLANE_INCL already existed in constants.rs — a duplicate addition was caught and removed. Sutra guard on context.rs required calling sutra_impact to acknowledge before edits could proceed.

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review (vidhi-review, batch 49-52): approve with notes. x2000 threading is clean pure-additive (Result<([f64;24],[f64;6]),_>), non-sidereal golden tests (calc/calc_sweph/jpl) unchanged — 63 passed. ECL_T0/SSY math matches C FP notes (ECL_T0 in radians, SSY in degrees; position+speed precessed in separate calls; obliquity uses flags not 0). FOLLOW-UP swisseph-rs/53: the SSY/ECL_T0 branches break lon_speed (→0) under SIDEREAL|SPEED3 because apply_sidereal recomputes from x2000's zeroed velocity on that path. Verified empirically. Not blocking the SPEED/analytic path which is correct and tested.
